tickets.name: Off the Tip
tickets.note: Here comes Bucks at Magic, and the opening tip is where our night begins! The jump ball goes Carter against Turner, and Carter has the springs tonight! Advantage Magic for the opening bucket. And if the Bucks flip the script, Turner is waiting right there to pounce!

tickets.name: Early Offense
tickets.note: Knicks at Pacers, and here's how we see the opening act! Towns and Zubac meet at center court, and it's anybody's tip! This opening could break either way, and we know which way we're leaning! Oubre is the sneaky finisher on that opening trip!

tickets.name: Ice Breaker
tickets.note: Next up, Grizzlies at Pelicans, and the first trip down the floor is circled in red! It's Stewart against Matkovic in the circle, and neither one has the edge! Wide open at the start, and we're riding the Pelicans! Should Matkovic get the tip, the ball comes right back to him. First look, baby!

tickets.name: Lead the Break
tickets.note: Lights up for Hawks at Bulls, and we know exactly who we want touching the ball early! Okongwu squares up with Smith for the opening tip, and we like Okongwu to control it! Toss-up at the tip, but we trust the Hawks to cash the first trip! If Okongwu controls the tip, he taps it to a guard, rolls to the rim, and boom, he's the first look!

tickets.name: First Touch
tickets.note: Cavaliers and Heat, and the first bucket of this one has our fingerprints all over it! The jump ball pits Allen against Adebayo, a true fifty-fifty! Either side can strike first here, and we like the Heat to make it count! Give Adebayo the tip and he's sprinting to the block. Feed the big man!

tickets.name: Two Points
tickets.note: It's Warriors and Spurs, and buddy, we've got a plan for the opening act! It starts with Wembanyama against Green at center court, and our money says Wembanyama gets up there first! So the Spurs should get the first crack at it. If the Warriors steal the tip or get the first stop, Green is who we want firing first!
